# ellmos-tests

ellmos-tests is a Python test framework for SKILL.md-based LLM operating systems and agent hubs.

Repository: https://github.com/ellmos-ai/ellmos-tests
Default branch: master
Version: 0.2.1
License: MIT
Primary language: Python (Standard Library first, RunAsInvoker)

## What It Does

- Runs B-tests (B001–B008) for static observation of files, structure, documentation, dependencies, and age.
- Runs O-tests (O001–O008) for functional checks including task roundtrips, memory persistence, tool registry checks, backup/restore, config validation, export/import, module findability (O007), and stack composition (O008).
- Defines E-tests (E001–E010) for evaluative experience tasks across onboarding, navigation, memory, tasks, tools, communication, and error tolerance.
- Provides reusable test batteries in `tests/batteries/*.txt` and customizable execution profiles.
- Provides feature-mapping and cross-system comparison workflows with SQLite database (`system_diff_tests/`).
- Includes machine-readable use-case catalog in `usecases.json`.

## Important Commands

```bash
python tests/run_batteries.py --list
python tests/run_batteries.py --battery release_smoke --system-path "/path/to/system"
python system_diff_tests/run_all.py "/path/to/system"
python system_diff_tests/testing/run_external.py "/path/to/system" --profile STANDARD
python -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py"
pytest
```

## Audience & Target Personas

- **[PERSONA-01] LLM-OS Architect & System Engineer**: Building or extending SKILL.md-based systems (BACH, recludOS, custom agent hubs) needing structured B/O/E quality metrics.
- **[PERSONA-02] AI Agent Framework Evaluator**: Benchmarking agent operating systems across onboarding, memory persistence, tool routing, and cognitive recovery.
- **[PERSONA-03] Autonomous Agent QA & CI/CD Engineer**: Running automated regression checks and test batteries before deploying agent updates.
- **[PERSONA-04] Enterprise LLM Integrator & Compliance Auditor**: Requiring zero-egress local isolation, unprivileged RunAsInvoker security, and verifiable SLAs.

## Notes For Agents

- Keep this repository lightweight and standard-library-first.
- Do not commit generated output, local result JSON, `__pycache__`, or private BACH context.
- German user-facing documentation should use real umlauts (`ä`, `ö`, `ü`, `Ä`, `Ö`, `Ü`, `ß`), not `ae`, `oe`, or `ue`.
- All Mermaid diagrams must observe syntax guardrails: quote rectangle node labels and avoid semicolons in sequence diagrams.
